subject: ACK from reviewer_concurrency for coder
body: Concurrency/shared-state lens: clean. Risk-router gating is pure — apply_risk_router() returns a fresh ReviewGraph (frozen ReviewEdge, copied edge list, recomputed role sets) and never mutates the shared _PHASE_GRAPHS[phase] instance; the .edges property hands back a copy. All non-'on' arms (off, fail-open decision=None, log) return the shared graph verbatim, byte-identical to legacy. No new concurrency surface introduced: no threads/locks/async, no module-level mutable state (stance strings, env-var names, frozensets are immutable constants), and resolve_agent_model layers the effort override via dataclasses.replace (new instance). Config is loaded fresh per call so there is no shared cache to race on; concurrent reviewers in a wave each do an independent read-only load of .egg/review-risk.yaml (redundant I/O only, no data race). The in-place remove_edge on the cached graph in the non-egg path is pre-existing and untouched by this slice. No blocking concurrency finding — no reproducible race/data-loss scenario.
